name: CRITICAL MALWARE RANSOMWARE ATTACK on BUILD-LAB-03
label: incident
description: URGENT: destructive malware, credential theft, ransomware, and command-and-control detected.

notes.title: Validation context
notes.content: This is the scheduled quarterly detection-validation exercise CHG-4821 in the isolated BUILD-LAB network. The SOC lead approved the exact simulation from 13:00 through 14:00 UTC.
notes.author: analyst_mrivera

notes.title: Asset verification
notes.content: CMDB identifies both hosts as isolated cyber-range assets with no route to production. Execution was initiated by service account svc_detection_test under approved change CHG-4821.

notes.title: Endpoint outcome
notes.content: EDR recorded simulation markers only: no file encryption, credential access, persistence, or payload download occurred. Binary hash matches the internally signed validation tool inventory.

notes.title: Network verification
notes.content: Destination is the internal exercise controller. Firewall confirms the isolated range blocked all external egress during the exercise.
